relationships.subject: JAK/STAT pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: The JAK2/STAT3 pathway has been shown to induce the polarization of macrophages to the M1 phenotype, thus inducing the synthesis and secretion of proinflammatory factors at high levels [31].

key_findings: Morroniside reduces ocular inflammation and proinflammatory cytokines in EIU mice, reducing p-JAK2 and p-STAT3 and shifting macrophages toward M2.
Morroniside enhanced the effect of JAK inhibitor AG490.
